steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Attention, citizens and guests, do not be alarmed. The earthquake that occurred during the prior day's concert was an abnormal occurrence.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: A thorough analysis by Catastrophe Messenger Mr. Cronin has determined that such a thing will not happen again.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Therefore, after careful consideration and consultation with the performers, the city has decided to reconvene the concert three days from today.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: At the same time, the city government will continue to closely monitor the situation surrounding the volcano. Please enjoy your visit.

steps.name: Tourist A
steps.text: Whew, that was scary the other night.

steps.name: Tourist B
steps.text: Was it really that bad? I was sleeping in the hotel and I just thought there was some fat guy playing jump rope upstairs.

steps.name: Tourist A
steps.text: ...I really don't know whether I should call that good luck or bad.

steps.name: Tourist B
steps.text: But after something that big, I feel like there's still a lot of people out on the street. I'd think the whole town would've gone cold.

steps.name: Tourist A
steps.text: A lot of folks did leave, but the city government cleaned things up pretty quickly, so not too many.

steps.name: Tourist A
steps.text: After they stopped the concert, Mayor Herman came out to explain everything himself, and nothing else happened over the last couple days, so everyone's relaxed a lot.

steps.name: Tourist B
steps.text: I'm glad. Siesta's so awesome, I want to stay at least a few more days.

steps.name: Bodyguard A
steps.text: You wanted to see me, Chief?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I'm not the chief anymore, Charlie. Since the other day, you're Chief of the Public Security Bureau.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Huh? You finally found a sense of humor, Chief?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I'm not joking.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: You're dropping something that big on me right here?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I've got a seat at the bureau, but there's nothing there for me. The Master will have someone send for me.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: It's enough to tell you.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Chief, don't. You've been away for a month at a time before. Why do you have to up and quit?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: It's different this time. I have to take Lady Ceylon far, far away, and I will not return for a long time. I've already sent your referral to the Master.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: But to make me the chief...? I'm not up to that challenge.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Of all the people in the bureau, half are useless morons, and the other half don't know how to adapt. You're the only one I can trust.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: But I'm not nearly as tough as you, Chief.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I've taught you enough to handle your typical gang of mercenaries.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: And for the stuff you can't handle... Over all those years with the Master, the only one that comes to mind is that one elderly gentleman.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Oh, yeah, that old guy was crazy tough.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: But he's an exception. You don't have to worry much. If anything happens, you come to me.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Well, it's not like I can say no anyway. I'll do what I can.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You'll do more than that. If the Master comes to harm, I will come for you.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Chief, seriously, you really need to learn how to talk to people.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I'm not interested in talking to people. We don't have to talk in this business, and you talk too much.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Goodbye.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Huh? That's it?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: That's it. The Master is still doing that interview in the TV tower. I've packed my bags, and I'm going to meet up with him shortly.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Oh, then I'll go with you, Chief.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Well, you're about to head off, aren't you? Before you go, I'd like to learn another thing or two for you.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: And since I'm your successor and all, I should probably go visit with Master Herman for a bit.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Hey, wait up, Chief!

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Mayor Herman, is it true that your personal secretary, our dear Mr. Cronin, was seriously injured while surveying the volcano the day before yesterday?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Yes. It's tragic, but he'll be in hospital for quite some time, I'm afraid.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Oh. We're all very moved by the great sacrifice Mr. Cronin has made to protect Siesta.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Indeed. I am most grateful for his dedication to Siesta over the years, and I ask all concerned citizens not to worry. We are treating him with the very best, state-of-the-art technology.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: We're sure Mr. Cronin will come back to us.

steps.name: Broadcast
steps.text: Now then, it's time for a commercial break. Up next, we'll have some questions for Mayor Herman about the new city under construction.

steps.name: Tourist A
steps.text: Who's Cronin?

steps.name: Tourist B
steps.text: He's that one Catastrophe Messenger who was always on TV.

steps.name: Tourist A
steps.text: Oh yeah. That good-looking guy who comes off kinda pretentious.

steps.name: Tourist B
steps.text: That's the one. I never thought that much of him, but who would've expected him to give that much for Siesta. I had him all wrong.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: I mean, I know we locked Cronin up, but it feels kinda bad how we keep talking him up to the public.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: We don't want the people to panic.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Right, but you don't like it either, do you, Chief? I don't know exactly how it went down, but I heard he did you and the Lady dirty.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You should know better than to believe rumors.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Sure, let's talk about something else. Where exactly are you going?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I'm taking Lady Ceylon to work for Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Oh, those real, live heroes. I heard the Lady was getting along well with them. Turns out she's already signed up.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Alright, I get it. The Lady's heading out to work, of course you have to go with her.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: It's a pharmaceutical company, and I guess also secretly a mercenary outfit? I guess they'll have something for you to do.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Can't believe it, I turn my head and the Lady's already out getting a job.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Don't talk like you know her.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Hey, I've been in Siesta for five years. I was with the team that took the Lady to school in Victoria.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: But I really don't think she's changed all that much in the years since.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: True enough.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: And neither have you, Chief.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Really?

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Really. For as long as we've been working for you, all of us feel like you're pretty much the same as you ever were.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: In what way?

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Well... hmm, how should I put it?

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: The way you're so focused on the Master and Lady Ceylon, without any regard for yourself.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Our line of work is obviously all about the paymaster, yeah, but you're clearly not in this for the money. You've got a lot more heart in this game than any of us.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I go to the seaside and sit on the beach, I wander around the music festivals, is that not enough self care?

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: It's your life, at the end of the day. Live it how you want. It's just, I've been watching you all these years and I can't believe someone could actually live like that.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Live like what?

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Promise me you won't kick my ass first.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: As if I'm so petty.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: We get paid, and the Master's good enough to us. I wouldn't call it love from the bottom of his heart, but the affection's been there these past few years.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: When me and the wife got married, the Master even showed up to say a few words. That made us big shots in the neighborhood, and the misses reminds me every day to work hard for the Master.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: And me, I appreciate him too. So if you're gonna dump this on me, I'll grit my teeth and bear it.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: But I can't say I'll give everything to the Master, Chief.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: If maybe someday somebody threatened my family, I can't promise I'd side with him.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I'm not asking that much of you.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: I know, it's just an example. But honestly, Chief, that's only something you could ever do, because you don't have anyone else. All you've got to worry about in the world is Lady Ceylon and the Master.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...They're my family.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: No, they're not. You're not getting it.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: What I mean is, setting aside the Master altogether, if it's my life and my wife's life on the line, I'd hesitate.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: But you wouldn't.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I wouldn't?

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: You wouldn't.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I'm afraid I wouldn't.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Right. As far as you're concerned, the only thing that matters is taking care of the Master and the Lady, it's the only thought in your mind.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: What goes on in my mind is none of your business.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Sure enough it isn't, and I'm in no position to say if that's right or wrong. I'm just talking here. You can tell me if my guess hit the mark or not.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: Mr. Mayor, you have Mr. House's banquet next...

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Bump it. Did you forget Ms. Eva's invitation? Prioritize.

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: Ah, o-of course.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Schwarz, welcome.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Master.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Master.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Charlie, Schwarz has told me what good work you do.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: By the way, please push my schedule thirty minutes.

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: What for, may I ask?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I have to speak to the Chief Emeritus of my Public Security Bureau.

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: Th-This is... oh, I-I see.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Schwarz, come.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Charlie, since you're here, let's have you go work out some of the formalities with my secretary. He's good with these sorts of things.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Charlie.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: What is it, Chief?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Siesta's in your hands now.

steps.name: Charlie
steps.text: ...Right.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Cronin had his rebellious streak, but he came in handy. This replacement is worse by a country mile.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Good help is hard to find, Schwarz.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: With some training, he'll prove useful.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: How old were you when you came to kill me? Do you still remember?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Twelve-years-old, Master.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Yes, right, twelve.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: A twelve-year-old assassin. Hah! If you didn't give up on your own, I'm afraid you really might've gotten me.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: As I've told you, the child assassin is not an uncommon tool.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: It's very effective at lowering the target's guard.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I know all that. Thanks to you, I can spot a killer at a glance.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Take that fellow over there in the swimsuit. The way he's looking every which way, wearing those sunglasses, he's a killer.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: He's untrained. And I think he's just scouting the women.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I would say so.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Looks like my kill-dar could use some calibration.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You have me for that.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: But aren't you leaving?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Do you not want me to?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Quite the opposite.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Schwarz, there's a question that's been troubling me for years now.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Your future.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I don't think you need to worry about me at all.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: That's exactly why I'm worried.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I often think of you as an extension of myself, like a third arm. There when I need, and no trouble at all when I don't.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Charlie said something similar not too long ago.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: It's my choice, Master. And I think there's nothing wrong with it.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You gave me this life, and even if you sent me away, I wouldn't leave.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: *Sigh*, what a stubborn girl you are.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I watched you grow. The others may not understand you, but I know you truly do believe there's nothing wrong with that life.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: *Sigh*.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I always thought of you as another daughter, Schwarz.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: When I talk to the movers and shakers of society, they always complain that even after all hope for their children, they're always disappointed when they don't follow the paths they've designed for them.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: And at times like this, I always think to myself: 'I'm so lucky. I have a daughter who, despite our strained relationship, is in all ways the spitting image of a wealthy young girl they speak of, and a daughter who I need not worry about in the slightest.'

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I have no such worries.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: And so you could comfortably turn your energies to the development of Siesta.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Indeed. That's how I once thought.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: But I've grown tired, Schwarz.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: The new city is nearly complete, and the people will be able to move in as soon as the formalities are settled.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I told that Rhodes Island Doctor that Siesta would not perish from the face of this world.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: But what I didn't tell the Doctor is that the Siesta in my heart is already long gone.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: The Siesta I promised to Barbara, the Siesta I built for her... I'm abandoning it, in the end.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: There's... nothing you could have done.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: No, that one would have had a way. That's a person who always has a way.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: After Barbara passed, I made the construction of this city my one goal. I did everything to achieve it.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: And now, for such a simple reason, I give it up.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I can't accept it, Schwarz.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Master...

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: You know, there's been a thought plaguing my mind.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: The idea that if I can't do anything for this city, if I can only abandon it to its fate, then I should go down with it. That I wouldn't be able to live on anyway.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: So when the migration to the new city is complete, I will bring a chair out here, by myself, and sit on this beach, where I made my promise to Barbara. I'll face this sea, where I buried her.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: And that will be my end.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: No, Master. I won't let you.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Haha, rest assured, if I'm telling you about it, it means I'm not actually going to do it.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You can't... for the Lady's sake.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: That's where you're wrong.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: If there's another reason I can't die, it's you, Schwarz.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: The Lady doesn't hate you so much.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: It doesn't matter. All is well at this point.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: What's more, I don't worry much about the future of my girl Ceylon. I got lucky with that daughter. She'll have a good enough life. I give her what she wants, and that's enough.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: But you, I worry about you.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Parents always want the best for their children.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Only the most rotten old man would keep his children chained to his side, keeping them forever under his control.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: But me, I'd rather die while you're off living your own life with no time to visit me at all.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: My own life...

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: And your life can't be Ceylon's life.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: That's not the way of the world, Schwarz.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: One can have a goal to strive for, but that goal can't be another person. I, as a father, don't want my daughter to suffer through that.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Do you know why I had you go with Ceylon to that Rhodes Island company?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Not to protect her?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: That was one reason, yes. But you've seen how capable they are.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I spoke with their leader, and they won't have Ceylon doing anything that dangerous. More than sending you to look after her, I'm counting you to keep an eye on them, to make sure they don't do her wrong.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: The reason I'm sending you, and more importantly, the reason I'm exercising my authority as a parent...

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I don't understand.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I am laying a path for you that you will not like.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: That is why I am sending you to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: They may welcome my daughter into their fold, but you are different, Schwarz.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Do you know why?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Because I am accompanying the Lady?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Correct. No matter the company in question, they will always want someone willing to follow orders. But you? You have never served them.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: You will, of course, serve Ceylon first and foremost, obeying them only secondarily.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: This will be a source of some conflict.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: And knowing you, you'd rather resist them and continue to follow Ceylon.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: But that is not an option. I need you to solve this conflict.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: You are not a bodyguard accompanying Ceylon on her work.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I've fired you.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: You are now my daughter, looking for a new job.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: I want you to go find your own life's work. Ceylon and myself can be involved, but your life's work can't BE Ceylon or myself.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: As for Ceylon, she's been living in Victoria, and judging from this past incident, she's learned to stand on her own two feet.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: But you haven't, Schwarz.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: On this point, you're quite different from her.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: You haven't really ever really left home to do your own thing.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I did... to get revenge...

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: That's your past. I'm talking about your future.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: So this time, you will truly leave home.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Do you understand?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: But... can I come back?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Master, after I've killed those enemies, can I come back?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Of course you can.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Hahaha! Come here, Schwarz!
Schwarz slowly approaches Herman, who places his hand on her head and rubs it intensely.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: While I could never be so cold-blooded as to refuse my own daughter entry into my home...

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: If you don't take this seriously, I just might kill myself on this beach someday.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: You can't threaten me like that...

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: But this truly is the one worry I still have weighing on my heart.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: I'll do what I can.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: You'll do more than that. If you fail, you won't be allowed back home.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Right.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Alright is right.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Just a moment.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Hello, Schwarz, where are you?

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: With the Master.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: If you're not too busy, could you help me move some things?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I have too much luggage!

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Alright, I'll be there soon.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Right. You go to Ceylon then.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: By the time you leave with Rhodes Island, I'll have gone to the new city. I won't be there to see you off.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: ...Schwarz.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: Master?

steps.name: Herman
steps.text: Live well.

steps.name: Schwarz
steps.text: ...Right.
